title: Today's to-do list: one honest overlay on a normal clip
summary: Film yourself getting ready or working, then add one overlay: "Today's to-do list". AI helps you write a list that's short, real and a little funny.
why: An Instagram trends roundup dated October 27, 2026 lists "Today's to-do list": a casual clip of the creator getting ready or working, with the overlay "Today's to-do list" and a list of everyday tasks, set to a trending sound.
steps: Film one relaxed clip of 5 to 10 seconds: making coffee, getting ready, opening the shop or sitting down to work.
Use the main prompt to turn your real plans for the day into a short list. Pick the version that sounds most like you.
Add the title "Today's to-do list" at the top and the list underneath, in large text that is easy to read on a phone.
Pick a trending sound in the app and post. Ask people to share their own list in the comments.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Here are the things I really need to do today: [paste your rough list]. Turn them into a "Today's to-do list" for a short video overlay. Keep it to 5 or 6 items, each under 6 words. Keep the real tasks, but make one or two of them a little funny or honest, like "drink the coffee while it's still hot". Put the items in the order I'd actually do them. Write 3 versions: calm, chaotic and very honest.

prompts.label: Variation: the honest twist
prompts.text: Write a "Today's to-do list" with 5 items for a short video. The first 4 should sound productive and normal, like "reply to emails" and "go for a walk". The last item should be a gentle, relatable twist that shows what really happened, like "move all of this to tomorrow". Keep each item under 6 words. My day is about: [your day]. Keep it kind and light, no jokes about anyone else.

prompts.label: Variation: checked off
prompts.text: I want to film the same clip twice: once in the morning and once at night. Write a "Today's to-do list" with 5 items for the morning version. Then write the night version of the same list, with a check mark or an honest note beside each item, for example "done", "half done" or "tomorrow". My plans: [your list]. Keep each line short enough to read in 2 seconds.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run [type of business] in [town]. Write a "Today's to-do list" for a short video of me opening up. Use 5 or 6 real tasks from a normal day, like [example tasks]. Make one item warm and personal, like "say hi to our regulars". Add a one-line caption that invites people to drop by or ask a question. No made-up sales, numbers or customer quotes.

tips: Use your real day. The trend works because the list is ordinary and believable.
Keep the list short. If people need to pause the video to read it, cut items.
Leave the text on screen for the whole clip, so it's easy to read before it loops.
Pick the sound inside the app so it's licensed for your post.
